# Labelling task: pendulum.avoid_left_swing

Environment: Pendulum-v1

## The behaviour to identify

  Swing up using only the right half of the circle.

## Notes on the features

  The bob position is (sin_theta, cos_theta); cos_theta=+1 is upright.
